title: Where do I go from here?
author: Trugus69
selftext:
I’m in my 40s, been gaming as long as I can remember. Worked on a half life mod with some friends back in the day, but no REAL way to put my ideas anywhere… then AI came about, I’m learning, and it may be “slop” now but I’m working on it.

This current little thing I have goin, you control the characters like an rts? Select them and move them around, plant some veggies, keep them watered… refill your water bucket, and when your crate is full you drop it at the shop so people can buy it… then you upgrade… 

Besides the messed up UI and such, anyone have any insight on direction? Thoughts? It’s like I started something with half a thought and never finished it lol.

comments.author: EchoingAngel
comments.body: Seems like this is just a learning exercise. If you don't know the game beginning to end before you start, the chances it turns into something good (without taking FOREVER) is very low.

replies.author: CycleMother2006
replies.body: I don't think you need to necessarily know the end, but you should at least have a core game loop. Fortnite started out with the game loop 'Stylized gun play tower defense with building mechanics, loot drops, and waves of zombies.' and became something totally different. But even its initial iteration had a very clearly defined gameplay loop.

replies.author: EchoingAngel
replies.body: That's like how my game had zero scope creep until the third playthrough and I realized I was leaving a lot of fun and satisfaction on the table with one "simple" rework. I had to get to the "stopping point" before the reality could be found

comments.author: Ill-Past4609
comments.body: Did you ever design a GDD ? If not I would ask ChatGPT “ create a GDD for an idea I have ask questions for full phase completion from starting game core loop to end game” then you describe what you to build and in the end just tell it, I don’t have a clear path for end game or what else to implement so let me know

comments.author: Pizzaman2948
comments.body: Im making something like your game, it will have life skills you can level up but probably way worse graphics 😂

comments.author: RamonDozol
comments.body:
the looks makes me want to grow plants, have some animals ( chikens, cow, etc) and also cook tasty looking things with them. 

The game could then turn into a restaurant/farming cozy game, with progression and secret recipes to discover ( exploration of combinations of hundreds of raw and processed ingredients ( milk, fat, eggs, meat > cheese, butter, ground beef, sausage, etc)

extra points if the "characters" make some funny faces or animate in a funny/ cute way when they like, dislike something.   
( might even become a game thing, to learn what each creature likes and hates, and avoid giving them the things they hate, to increase their "liking" and open new recipes, items, and buildings.)

comments.author: Trugus69
comments.body: The funny part about it, I generally have no interest in farming games or the like. I appreciate all y’all feedback, love how it’s not too judgmental lol. I actually came up with a bit more of an idea for it, guess we’ll see how implementation goes lol.
